summary: Backend testing for iteration 53 travel rule changes: new fatigue-save (+1 exact on fail, multi-role -5, base CD per terrain 10/15/20) and generate-narrative optional notas_maestro/clima. Created 10 new tests in test_travel_rules_it53.py. All 37 tests (new + prior camp_fatigue + it52 regression) PASS.
critical_code_review_comments: travel_routes.py is >2900 lines long — consider splitting into sub-modules (fatigue, journey lifecycle, narrative, pathfinding) to reduce coupling and ease maintenance. Non-blocking for this iteration.

/api/travel/fatigue-save uses GET-like query params on a POST body-less endpoint (FastAPI query params). Consider a Pydantic request model for clearer OpenAPI schema and to mirror the style of /apply-px-individual. Non-blocking.
generate-narrative does load_dotenv() on every request; prefer loading once at app startup to avoid file IO overhead per call.
Terrain→CD mapping in journey/start is hardcoded (cd=10/15/20) — consider moving to the travel_rules document so GM can tweak without code deploy.
seed_data_creation: Used existing locations collection (244 docs) for journey/start test. Test-scoped journeys/characters are cleaned up via fixtures.
context_for_next_testing_agent: New travel rules tests live in /app/backend/tests/test_travel_rules_it53.py. Key verifications: fatigue-save ALWAYS returns niveles_cansancio==1 on fail (never 2/3), penalizacion_multiples_papeles reported as -5 in tirada breakdown, journey/start sets fatiga_cd_total to one of {10,15,20}. generate-narrative accepts notas_maestro + clima as optional query params. All 27 prior it52/camp tests still pass.
rca of the issue: No bug found. Initial journey/start test was skipped because the test used the wrong Mongo collection name (map_locations vs locations). Fixed by reading from the correct `locations` collection (244 documents).
